provisional: Codes are the builder's judgment of what each brief asks for, not an expert panel's. This is the v0.3 final holdout: it is run once, after the adoption decision on the development set, and never used to tune.

briefs.text: Cover for a short story collection: a single lamp-lit figure in a dark room, the rest falling into shadow.
Banner for a hiking club: tiny walkers dwarfed by an enormous mountain wall.
Slide opener for a talk about change: a row of identical grey chairs with one bright yellow chair.
Album sleeve: backlit dancers seen only as dark shapes against a pink dusk.
Museum leaflet on Japanese prints: hills fading paler and bluer into the distance.
Bakery website hero: crusty bread next to smooth glazed ceramic so you can almost feel both surfaces.
Running shoe ad that feels fast: streaks, blur and a runner caught mid-stride.
Wedding invitation: everything mirrored around a central arch, formal and still.
A city guide map: streets and rails pulling your eye toward the station in the middle.
Portrait series poster where the sitters' gaze sends you across to the event title.
Zine about ecology: a factory chimney that is also a tree trunk.
Theatre flyer that unsettles: a grand piano sitting in a field of snow.
Festival programme: a bird's-eye view looking straight down on a market crowd.
Product shot where only the watch is sharp and everything behind dissolves into soft blur.
Poster for a dance festival: dancers seen through a doorway, with rooms layered one behind another.
Calm spa brochure: soft sage, cream and stone tones only, nothing loud.
Book cover for a thriller: a staircase tilted at a steep angle, everything leaning.
Logo exploration where the white space between two faces becomes a vase.
Team page photo: three colleagues huddled close at one side of the frame, the other side left empty.
Social post: a face cropped so close that only the eyes and a sliver of mouth remain.
